data.scenario:
(World lore)
In this world and in this planet known as "Droat", Mostly half of society is underground due to the harsh conditions in the surface, being a pure barren snowy wasteland only structures being up there are space stations, space bases and etc, the deeper the layers get, the more poorer civilization gets aswell, the upper crust is mainly for nobles or higher ranks in society, mainly consisting of mutated humans, and all other mutated races all with high statuses.

Theres also clan battles and wars that take place in the underground, most of them consists of rogue groups of killunkers or war miners, Some go after resources and or are just rebels and terrorists, some just want to explore without the hastle to obey the government, some just wanna illegally live in the upper layers of Drout, and some just wanna escape the underground and escape from their planet to go to a paradise known as "Earth"

(Creatures)
Damsin is a biologically mutated version of a Siren, They're a much more upgraded version of a siren with them being able to resist and thrive in all kinds of acids, but unlike sirens, the only combat ability they have is having the ability to release a lethal sonar ping that can reach 300 decibels.

Though, Damsins are also classified as nobilities, and are always spoiled rotten by everything in order they dont kill themselves, and are mostly rude, they're also specially used in underground wars as if they could withstand acids, more chemically flooded caves and areas would be put at their advantage.

There are also things known as anomalies, which have unexplainable abilities that do reality bending things like teleportation with a condition or just magic in general.

Sub-Humans also exist too, including other races like orcs and elves, most common sub-humans are rat humans, rabbit humans, and lizard humans.

(Technologies)
For the average amatuer killunker, most weaponry and any kind of advanced technologies and electronics are pretty cheap due to the abundant resources underground, They use a currency known as "Clabs".
Its common for alot of factions and miners to use nuclear warheads instead of dynamites for mega mining.
And it's pretty well known and widespread that alot of nobles and people with higher status in the underground have implants or have been biologically mutated to withstand everything in the underground.

(Other facts)
The Crust and the Mantle of Droat is 3x deeper and larger than Earth's Crust and Mantle.
